_comment: Taught words the frequency corpora never saw, and why each one is absent.
`content:coverage` requires every row to be at 100%, and 'Frequency evidence
(observed)' is the one row that measures something outside this repository:
whether two OpenSubtitles corpora happen to contain a word. A subtitle corpus
is a sample of speech, and there are words a sample can miss.
The row is still checked, and it is checked more strictly than a percentage.
The rule is: **every unobserved word must be listed here with a reason a
person wrote.** A ninth word going unobserved fails the build exactly as a
missing example would, because nobody will have looked at it. What is no
longer required is that the number be 2,916/2,916 — that would be a
requirement on OpenSubtitles rather than on this corpus, and the only ways to
satisfy it are to delete good words or to invent a rank, which
`scripts/content/frequency.py` refuses to do in its own opening comment.
There is a real improvement available and it is not being made at the end of
a pass: the corpus *does* contain 다다익선이지 and 고진감래라더니, and it
contains 담백한 and 선선한. The matcher folds tokens by stripping a fixed list
of endings, so it cannot see an ending fused into the stem syllable (한, 해서)
and it cannot see a noun-idiom carrying 이지. Fixing that would re-rank the
whole corpus and move every difficulty score, every level and the level test
with them. It belongs in its own change, with its own before-and-after.

words.일석이조: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold inflected phrases, not the bare noun

words.고진감래: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 고진감래라더니
words.다다익선: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 다다익선이지

words.동문서답: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold inflected phrases, not the bare noun
words.선선하다: a 하다 adjective; the corpora hold 선선한 and 선선해서, whose ending is fused into the stem syllable
words.담백하다: a 하다 adjective; the corpora hold 담백한 and 담백해서, whose ending is fused into the stem syllable
words.결자해지: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.동병상련: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form

words.유유상종: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.이심전심: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.일거양득: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 일거양득이란
words.조삼모사: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.천고마비: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.노심초사: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold 노심초사했어요 and 노심초사할, the 하다 verb, never the bare noun this card teaches
words.다재다능: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold 다재다능한 and 다재다능하지, never the bare noun
words.대동소이: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 대동소이합니다, never the bare noun
words.비일비재: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 비일비재하죠, never the bare noun
words.반려: the corpora hold 반려자, 반려동물 and 반려했습니다 — two compounds and the 하다 verb — but never 반려 standing alone, which is the noun this card teaches
words.매만지다: the corpora hold only 매만지기 and 매만지자는; the fold strips neither the nominaliser -기 nor -자는
words.불거지다: a -지다 verb; neither corpus contains any form of it
words.빚어지다: a -지다 verb; neither corpus contains any form of it
words.저조하다: the corpora hold only the adnominal 저조한 (five occurrences, 2018 list). The fold indexes a token by what is left after an ending is stripped, and 저조한 has nothing to strip because the ㄴ is fused into 한 — so it reaches neither the noun table nor the verb one
words.지긋하다: the corpora hold only the adnominal 지긋한 (two occurrences in each list); the fused ㄴ puts it out of the fold's reach, as with 저조하다. 지긋지긋하다, which both corpora do hold, is a different word
words.각박하다: a 하다 adjective; the corpora hold only 각박하구만 and 각박해져 — a colloquial ending and an -어지다 derivation, neither of which the fold strips back to the lemma
words.동분서주: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.박학다식: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only the bare 박학, once in each list, never the four-character form
words.성찰하다: the corpora hold 성찰 only inside the compound 자기성찰, never standing alone and never as the 하다 verb
words.적반하장: a four-character idiom; neither corpus contains it in any form
words.주객전도: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 주객이 — the two-character 주객, never the idiom
words.타산지석: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 타산과 — the two-character 타산, never the idiom
words.허심탄회: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold 허심탄회하게, 허심탄회하고, 허심탄회했잖아 and 허심탄회라고요 — inflected 하다 phrases, never the bare noun this card teaches
words.구사일생: a four-character idiom; the corpora hold only 구사일생이죠 — the copula ending fused on, a complete token the fold cannot strip
words.역지사지: a four-character idiom; neither list contains it in any form
words.열악하다: the corpora hold only 열악한, 열악했어, 열악하기 and 열악하고요 — fused and derived forms the fold does not reach, the same class as 저조하다 and 지긋하다
words.청천벽력: a four-character idiom; both lists hold only 청천벽력같은 — the idiom with 같은 fused on as one token, never the bare noun
words.체감하다: the corpora hold only noun uses — 체감의, 체감온도, 체감상으로(는) and the unrelated 일체감 — never a verb form of 체감하다
